title_en: Dream of the Red Chamber (7/20): The Crabapple Poetry Club
note_en: The pattern 一边…一边… joins two actions happening at the same time, and each verb gets its own 一边: 一边吃螃蟹，一边作诗 "eating crabs as they wrote." English uses "while" or "as" once, but Chinese repeats the marker in front of both actions, as again in 一边评诗，一边比赛.
